summary.text: Patty Lundstrom is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 9 who has served since 2001 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her as the executive director of the Greater Gallup Economic Development Corporation.

paragraphs.text: Lundstrom earned a master's degree in public administration from New Mexico State University, according to Ballotpedia.
Her professional experience includes working as executive director of the Greater Gallup Economic Development Corporation.
Lundstrom assumed office in the New Mexico House in 2001 and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Appropriations and Finance Committee in the 2017 session and in the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Taxation and Revenue and the Transportation, Public Works and Capital Improvements committees.
